plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but still carries market exposure.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to maintain a small, reduced leveraged ETF exposure.
Reduce SPY to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
Buy META at 4% of the book, adding a quality tech name from the scanner.

This plan aims for risk-first growth with a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, focusing on risk-first growth. It maintains some market exposure with reduced leverage and concentration, aiming for a blend of stability and growth potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.

Buy META at 6% of the book, leaning into a high-scoring scanner setup.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. This approach significantly increases both potential upside and drawdown, with leveraged ETFs subject to decay. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% to prioritize income.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. It cuts high-beta names and leverage, but distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
